summary: Validated MIS vs dashboard parity for FY 2026-04 to 2027-03 using admin org on preview URL. Reproduced mismatch: MIS executive report returns emissions 1003.1705 and water/waste as 0, while dashboard shows emissions ~1388 and non-zero water/waste. Root causes isolated with API-level diagnostics and UI verification.

critical.issue: Water and waste are zero because MIS forwards explicit facility_ids to dashboard/environment services; this excludes org-level ESG records with facility_id null. Same period without facility filter returns Water Recycled 5720.72 and Waste Recovered 116032.

Total emissions mismatch with dashboard stats: MIS uses monthly-string-only aggregate_emissions query (1003.1705) while /api/dashboard/stats includes non-monthly period contributions (FY/CY/quarterly/proration), giving 1387.64. Gap is exactly 384.4695.

integration_issues.flow: Executive Dashboard vs MIS Executive Report parity
integration_issues.issue: Dashboard cards display Total Emissions 1,388, Water Recycled 5,721, Waste Recovery 1,16,032 and Renewable 92.29%, but MIS report still shows emissions 1003.17 with Water/Waste zero for same FY/all facilities.

issues: Console warnings: chart container width/height resolves to -1 intermittently
Console React warning: spreading props object containing key into JSX

action_items: Align MIS emissions logic with /api/dashboard/stats period handling (monthly + yearly/FY/CY/quarterly with proration) for FY parity.
For MIS water/waste parity, include org-level records when all facilities are selected (do not exclude facility_id null records by forcing facility_ids filter).
Keep supplier logic unchanged; confirmed suppliers_assessed remains 3.
After fixes, re-run parity on: emissions total, water recycled, waste recovered, renewable share for FY 2026-04 to 2027-03.
critical_code_review_comments: MIS mixes two non-equivalent data paths: aggregate_emissions for total emissions and dashboard_metrics/environment_detail for operational KPIs; period/filter semantics are inconsistent.
aggregate_emissions uses strict reporting_period string range and misses non-monthly records that dashboard stats includes.
Passing explicit facility_ids everywhere causes null-facility (org-level) ESG records to be dropped from water/waste calculations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use diagnostics JSON from this iteration. Key checks already proven: (1) facility sets are identical and all active, (2) emissions gap equals dashboard non-monthly contribution (384.4695), (3) water/waste become non-zero when facility filter is removed. Focus retest after code alignment.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 Emissions gap: MIS total (1003.1705) equals dashboard monthly trend sum exactly; dashboard total (1387.64) adds non-monthly period contributions (384.4695). RCA-2 Water/Waste zero: MIS applies facility_ids filter and excludes org-level records (facility_id null). Without facility filter, same APIs return Water Recycled 5720.72 and Waste Recovered 116032, matching dashboard cards. Supplier assessment remained stable at 3.
